def: a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach

occurrences.text: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
